minutes_text:
MINUTES OF A SPECIAL A MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
  December 3, 2012

1. OPENING CEREMONIES

  a. Call Meeting to Order

A special meeting of the Lomita City Council was called to order at 6:01 p.m. on Monday,
December 3, 2012, in the Council Chambers, Lomita City Hall, 24300 Narbonne Avenue.

  b. Roll Call

Those responding to roll call by Assistant City Clerk Shumway were COUNCILMEMBERS:
Gazeley, Savidan, Traina, Sanchez, and Mayor Estrada. Also present were City Manager Rock,
Assistant City Manager Sugano, City Attorney Hogin, and Assistant City Clerk Shumway.

2. ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

There were none.

CITY COUNCIL RECESSED TO CLOSED SESSION at 6:02 p.m.

Councilmember Sanchez recused himself on Item 2 of the closed session agenda due to fact
that he resides within 500 feet of the Islamic Center of the South Bay; Councilmember Sanchez
left the room during discussion of the item.

  CLOSED SESSION

3. CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL – Existing Litigation
Los Angeles County Superior Court Case No. BC470129
Islamic Center of the South Bay v. City of Lomita, et al.
United States District Court LA CV12-02418

4. CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL – Anticipated Litigation
Pursuant to Government Code section 54956.9(b)
Number of potential cases: 1
Letter from Steven H. Rosenbaum to City Attorney dated July 24, 2012

5. CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL—Initiation of litigation
Pursuant to Government Code section 54956.9(c)
Number of potential cases: 2

CITY COUNCIL RECONVENED TO OPEN SESSION at 6:41pm

6.  ORAL CLOSED SESSION ANNOUNCEMENT

  Page 1 of 2
 City Attorney Hogin made the oral closed session announcement. City Attorney Hogin stated
that the City Council convened to closed session at 6:02 p.m. and discussed items that were
listed on the posted agenda. No reportable action was taken.

  ADJOURNMENT

Meeting adjourned at 6:42 p.m.

Submitted,

__________________________________
Lena Shumway, Assistant City Clerk, CMC

  Page 2 of 2
